description:
Genes overlapping a region of one Ensembl Plants genome (max 5 Mb). species is an Ensembl name, e.g.
'pisum_sativum', 'vicia_faba', 'glycine_max' or 'lupinus_angustifolius'; chromosome names as in that assembly. Chromosome names differ by assembly: pea 1LG6..7LG7, narrow-leafed lupin LG01..LG20, soybean 1..20; faba bean uses ENA sequence accessions (e.g. OX451735.1).
name: genes_in_region
